senses.gloss: तश्ली तश्ली, f. in astron., trigon. = تثليث

तष्ट तष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. तक्ष्), pared,
hewn, cut, chiseled, split, made thin; fashioned.

तष्टृ, टा, m. a carpenter, a builder, a builder
of chariots; a N. of Viśva-karman, the architect of
the gods; N. of one of the twelve Ādityas; [cf.
त्वष्टृ.]

तस् तस्, cl. 4. P. तस्यति, &c., to fade
away, become exhausted, perish, wane;
to throw down; to cast upwards, reject, cast; [cf.
rt. तंस् and Eng. toss.]

तसर तसर, अम्, अस्, n. m. (?), (fr. rt.
तंस् ?), Ved. a shuttle.
तसीर तसीर, in astron. = तासीर, = تسيير

तस्कर तस्कर, अस्, m. (said to be derived
fr. अतस् and rt. कृ; according to others fr. तद् and
rt. कृ), a thief, a robber; (at the end of a comp.)
anything bad or contemptible [cf. चौर]; (in astron.)
N. of certain Ketus; a kind of pot-herb, Trigonella
Corniculata; a tree, Vangueria Spinosa [cf. मदन];
the ear; (ई), f. a passionate woman; N. of several
[]
plants, a sort of Mimosa, = तस्कर-स्नायु, Leea
Hirta, &c.
—तस्कर-ता, f. or तस्कर-त्व, अम्, n.
thievishness, thieving, theft; catching by means of
the ear, hearing.
—तस्कर-वत्, ind. like a thief.
—तस्कर-स्नायु, उस्, m. the plant Leea Hirta.

तस्तुव तस्तुव, अम्, n., Ved. an antidote
against poison (?).

तस्थु तस्थु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the weakest
cases of तस्थिवस्, perf. part. of rt. स्था), stationary,
immovable, motionless.
तस्दी तस्दी, in astron., hexagon, = تسْديس

तस्मात् तस्मात्, ind. (abl. of the pronom.
base 2. त), from that, on that account, therefore,
(correlative to यस्मात् and यद्.)

तास्कर्य तास्कर्य, अम्, n. (fr. तस्कर),
theft, robbery, larceny.

तास्यन्द्र तास्यन्द्र or तास्विन्द्र, अम्, n.,
N. of a Sāman.
तस्थिवस्, वान्, -थुषी, वत्, one who has stood.
